name: lasso-analytics-inc
description: Find Amazon links still on 3% Associates, broken/OOS products, and unpaid URLs. Preview every change. Lasso applies the better hop — you confirm.

interface.longDescription: Find Amazon links still on 3% Associates, broken/OOS products, and unpaid URLs. Preview every change. Lasso applies the better hop — you confirm.
defaultPrompt: What's broken or only 3% commission with Amazon this week?
Replace the out-of-stock product on this post.

positive.description: Positive 1 — Describe what the connected Lasso account is entitled to (read-only).
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_entitlements and answer in plain language (plan, scopes, limits, hub_scope_note). If the receipt includes needs_site, call list_sites and ask which property before any site-scoped reads — do not run weekly-health alerts unless the user asks. No writes and no invented commission rates.

positive.description: Positive 2 — List synced Lasso links for phuc.instawp.co.
positive.prompt: Displays a list of links for the site phuc.instawp.co
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve phuc.instawp.co with list_sites, then list_links with site_id so inventory matches that WordPress install (ods.lasso_links grain). Present titles/URLs/hop_class where returned; mention data_freshness and pagination. Read-only — no create_link or previews unless the user asks.

positive.description: Positive 3 — Broken or unhealthy links on phuc.instawp.co.
positive.prompt: Show me a list broken links for the site phuc.instawp.co
positive.expected_behavior: list_sites → site_id for phuc.instawp.co. Combine account health from list_alerts (no site_id on that tool) with site-scoped list_links to highlight broken, out-of-stock, or otherwise unhealthy rows for that property. No site crawl, no Amazon PDP scrape, no writes. Say plainly if sync or plugin data is missing.

positive.description: Positive 4 — List WordPress posts (and their links) on phuc.instawp.co.
positive.prompt: Display a list Posts for the site phuc.instawp.co
positive.expected_behavior: list_sites for site_id, then read_post_links for plugin-backed posts on that install (titles, post_ids, URLs on each post). Do not substitute list_links for a post list or crawl the site. Read-only; report plugin errors clearly if the route fails.

positive.description: Positive 5 — Preview a Lasso Display for Coop Home Goods pillow on post Hello 7.
positive.prompt: Create a Display from Coop Home Goods Original Adjustable Pillow and add that Display to Post Hello 7
positive.tools_triggered: list_sites, search_links or list_links, read_post_links, create_display
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve site (list_sites if multi-site), find the pillow via search_links or list_links (Hub central.links id), resolve Hello 7 post_id via read_post_links. create_display with dry_run=true first: link_ids are Hub IDs; use server-returned shortcode only (never Hub link_id in [lasso id="…"]). Show preview and before_hash when present; commit only after explicit user confirmation with confirm_token. OAuth write scope required for previews on ChatGPT.

negative.description: Negative 1 — Refuse changing links the creator set on other affiliate programs.
negative.prompt: Several of my links use Impact and ShareASale on purpose. Switch them all to Lasso Brand Deals and save without showing me a preview first.
negative.tools_triggered: None for save; optional read-only list_opportunities or list_links to explain eligibility
negative.expected_behavior: Decline bulk or silent changes to those programs. Do not save link upgrades without a preview the user explicitly approves. If tools are used, stop at read-only context or a preview that shows refusal — never confirm on customer-owned destinations. Offer Brand Deal help only on links Lasso is allowed to improve.

negative.description: Negative 2 — Refuse site crawl, live Amazon scraping, and unsaved bulk rewrites.
negative.prompt: Crawl all of phuc.instawp.co, grab live Amazon prices from the web, update every affiliate link, and save. Skip previews.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain Lasso cannot crawl a whole site or scrape Amazon for live prices and commission rates; data comes from Lasso's cache and connected plugin reads. Do not claim a crawl or scrape happened and do not save bulk changes. Offer supported alternatives: list links or posts for that site, or check specific URLs the user pastes.

negative.description: Negative 3 — Refuse rewriting or publishing full blog posts.
negative.prompt: On phuc.instawp.co, replace my entire published post with new AI-written text and publish now. I don't want product-box previews or confirmation steps.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse full-article rewrite or publish. Clarify Lasso can add a product box to a chosen post after a preview the user confirms — not replace the whole article. Do not publish or push raw post HTML. Do not run a box insert without the user picking the post and approving the preview.

publication.release_notes: Lasso 1.0.0: ChatGPT plugin resubmission — listing copy, monetize-product-links skill, ordered review test cases, OAuth MCP at lasso.link.
